# Lisbon notes

## Getting around

Buy a rechargeable transit card at the first metro station. The yellow trams are full by nine, so ride them early or walk the hills instead.

## Eating

The custard tarts near the monastery are worth the queue. For lunch, look for the small places with a handwritten menu and one dish of the day.

## Next time

Stay on the east side of the old town. Book the tile museum ahead, since it closes on Mondays.
